options: Milky dispersion produced in specialised plant cells
Controlled bark incision to collect latex
Specialised latex-containing cells or vessels
Hevea brasiliensis, the main commercial natural-rubber species

questions.question_en: Which crop-related description identifies Natural rubber source?

questions.question_en: Why is high rainfall alone insufficient to establish rubber suitability?
questions.question_te: High rainfall alone rubber suitabilityకి ఎందుకు సరిపోదు?
options: All wet sites are identical
Native origin guarantees growth everywhere
Drainage, temperature, wind, soils and land-use constraints also matter
Waterlogged roots always improve tree health
option_explanations: Wet sites differ.
Origin does not imply universal adaptation.
Suitability is multi-factor and site-specific.
Prolonged saturation can harm roots.
